_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, front ranks on the y=300 line, cavalry centres at y -180), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,723). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

shape_residual.reason: Tracked in #1841: the caracoling cavalry's turnaround at the end of the clip, the window where its heading flutters (the facing_flutter entry). Uids 3 and 4's men fall off their slots there on main too. Uid 3 fails on main 2c2955cc already, at this script's own state ticks (254.9 wu against the 30 wu threshold; the branch reads 162.5) and with 2-tick samples from tick 2 on the clip seed and perturbed seeds 1 to 4 (main 250.8 to 259.9, branch 162.5 to 221.9). Measured 2026-10-22 with 2-tick samples from tick 2 (even ticks): on main 2c2955cc uid 4's residual passes 25 wu at tick 1270 and reaches 31.3 at tick 1292 against the 30 wu threshold, failing on the clip seed and perturbed seeds 1 and 4 (31.3, 34.3, 52.2); on the branch with flank and rear contact at the defender's edge (#1845) it passes 25 wu at tick 1258 and reaches 56.3 at tick 1300, failing on all five (56.3 to 66.1). CI's dense delta, sampling odd ticks from the divergence at tick 953, reads main at 21.35, so there only the branch fails.

overlap.reason: Measured by tools/check.sh demo_defects on this tree, front-on-line deployment. uid1 (the player Infantry, pressed by the enemy foot) dips to nnd_min 1.56 wu against its 2.25 wu floor: transient press compression. uid8 (team 1's deep cavalry, 9 ranks) is under a continuous AI ATTACK order whose target re-selects mid-clip, and each retarget re-rotates the block before it has re-squared, compressing its own files: 2.97 wu against the 5.0 wu floor, the mechanism main already exempted for uid8 and #1546 tracks. uid3 (the player's charging cavalry) dips to nnd_min 3.48 wu against the 5.0 wu floor at tick 1294, in the 2-tick dense samples after the tick-1122 divergence. That reading is new with the row-major casualty close-up: the merge-base e81ea9fa passes at 6.49 wu. In the charge turnaround mounts 33 and 47, each about 150 wu off his slot, swap sides across each other on both trees; the close-up's different pairing after uid3's casualty brings them closer as they pass. #1804 tracks the swap. uid9 (14.5 wu) no longer needs the exemption. uid6 (team 1's Infantry, circled by the caracoling cavalry) dips to nnd_min 0.84 wu against its 2.25 wu floor at ticks 1178-1200 on this tree's own seed (2-tick samples; 0.95 on the declared tick 1180), while cavalry uid4 closes to 63-71 wu, out of contact. Perturbed seeds 1 to 4 read 1.62 to 2.14 here and 3.31 to 5.27 on merge-base a3714751: below the floor on five of five seeds here and none of five there, so the shift is systematic, not seed noise. uid6's pair with the cavalry keeps the centre-based contact range, but the clip's infantry pairs take the front-line extension (#1827), and which of them drives the shift is not yet identified; tracked by #1841.

path_crossing.reason: Charging cavalry paths cross during the cycle-charge breakthrough, disengagement wheel, and realignment: in the turnaround mounts about 150 wu off their slots swap sides across each other (#1804).

facing_flutter.reason: Measured on this tree's own seed, 2-tick samples: the cycle-charging cavalry, marching out of contact between charges, reverses its heading 10 times in a row from tick 1254 to 1280 (uid3) and 4 times from 1264 to 1272 (uid4), against a threshold of 3; state ticks every 2 from 1254 to 1280 let the regular scan read it. Perturbed seeds 1 to 4: uid3 5 to 8 here, 1 to 6 on merge-base a3714751 (one of four over 3); uid4 1 to 7 here (one over 3), 1 to 3 on the merge-base. Cavalry keeps the centre-based contact range itself; the clip's infantry pairs take the front-line extension (#1827), and the path from them to this flutter is not yet identified; tracked by #1841.
